Jordan (CSM): Heads-up — NimbleWave triggered a two-day spend surge tied to embeddings. QBR is on Friday; need a 1-slide incident + mitigation for the deck.
Tara (FinOps): 48h delta: +210% vs baseline. If sustained, projected month = ~$46k vs baseline $14k. Running a 30d sensitivity now.
spend-bot: Alert: account nimblewave exceeded soft threshold (daily $6.2k) at 2026-05-02T11:08Z.
Ibrahim (Onboarding): Requesting sample logs and their changelog for the last deploy. I'll schedule a 30m enablement focused on embed patterns and batching.
Nora (SRE): Quick checks: are they using per-request embedding calls or streaming batch endpoints? Also check their shard count on their vector DB; high-shard writes = cost compounding.
Jordan (CSM): They said they launched "Product Insights" last week. Ibrahim, please ask for top 200 queries + sample of 2k embed calls.
Tara (FinOps): Model playbook: 1) Switch to emb-small variant for non-critical flows (est. -40%). 2) Implement batching (est. -20 to -50% depending on request size). 3) Short-term soft cap at avg*1.25; hard cap at avg*2.
Nora (SRE): Tech play: move full-text analytics to nightly batch-upsert and rely on prefix caching for UI queries. Also reduce embedding dim 768->384 in trial.
Ibrahim (Onboarding): Scheduled enablement Tue 09:30 PT; invite requests logs + top queries.
Jordan (CSM): For the QBR slide: include 30s incident summary, delta numbers, proposed plays + % savings, enablement plan, and ask (quota tweak + one-week credit).
Tara (FinOps): Draft credit ask: 1 week of credits covering 50% of campaign overrun to mitigate renewal churn while they adopt fixes. I'll add the runway calc.
Jordan (CSM): API quick-fix we can propose during the campaign: `POST /v1/accounts/nimblewave/quotas {"daily": 20000}` — we can roll this back after controls in place.
Nora (SRE): I'll prepare a short checklist for their engineers: batch-size guidance, embedding client settings, and cache TTLs. ETA EOD.
Tara (FinOps): Action items: Tara -> final forecast + credit recommendation (EOD). Nora -> technical checklist (EOD). Ibrahim -> collect logs + run enablement. Jordan -> assemble QBR slide and circulate tomorrow AM.
Jordan (CSM): Thanks team. Will ping when deck link is up. :thumbsup:
